prompt: Reference images 1-3 show only the drawing style: take from them the line work, colors, shading and simplicity, never their content or characters. Reference image 4 is the main character: keep exactly its head, face, colors, markings, body proportions; change only pose, action and expression. Its ear on the viewer's left is folded down and its ear on the viewer's right stands up, exactly as in the reference image, whichever way it turns; when the character is seen from behind, the folded ear is on the viewer's right. SCENE: tall vertical picture: a thin plain wall divides the picture into two rooms side by side. LEFT ROOM: in the evening the main character sits on a plain chair playing an acoustic guitar, eyes happily closed, a big proud smile, a few small simple music notes float up from the guitar. RIGHT ROOM: a neighbour, a middle-aged man in striped pyjamas and slippers with messy hair, stands right at the wall and knocks on it with his fist, annoyed sleepy face, small shake lines around his fist. The flame on the tip of the main character's tail burns big, golden and bright with a few tiny sparks. LAYOUT: the dividing wall runs straight down the middle; the main character with the guitar is whole and large in the left room; the neighbour is whole in the right room; plain walls; no clock, no letters or numbers anywhere. If the picture has no specific place, its background is plain near-white paper, even and untinted. Colours: black ink and soft grey washes on cream paper. The only warm colours in the picture are the main character's orange tail flame and cheek marks; every other object — envelopes, paper, furniture, floors, walls — is ink and grey, never brown, beige or orange. Every surface is clean and unmarked: blank paper, blank screens, plain envelopes, plain walls, unprinted floor. Keep the main subject well inside the frame, away from the edges. Draw everything in exactly the drawing style of the style references.
